summary: Flex Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a $1.45 billion senior term loan credit facility with Citibank as administrative agent. The facility matures November 29, 2027, and was fully funded on May 29, 2026. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes including refinancing the existing 364-day facility used for the Electrical Power Products acquisition. The loan bears floating-rate interest at Term SOFR or Base Rate plus a margin based on debt ratings. Customary covenants and financial maintenance tests apply (Debt/EBITDA <4.00x, Interest Coverage >3.00x). This is a routine debt refinancing and not a special situation event.
